name: StageInfrastructureWorkbookCheck
transaction_boundary: short enqueue UnitOfWork only; discovery/parsing/staging occurs in INFRA_WORKBOOK_STAGE_V1 with bounded short checkpoints and one atomic validating-to-staged publication transaction per candidate
idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + job coalescing for same setting_revision
receipt_order: replay -> setting revalidate -> receipt -> durable_jobs insert/reuse -> audit -> commit
post_commit_work: INFRA_WORKBOOK_STAGE_V1 revalidates the exact setting/directory and data-instance identity, uses deterministic candidate/source/checkpoint identities, creates only non-authoritative validating runs/staging/proposals, and publishes a complete candidate to staged/reviewable atomically; recovery never mixes workbook generations or retracts already-published review runs
